# Deepakkumar V — Full Stack Developer Portfolio

> Deepakkumar V (also known as Deepak) is a Full Stack Developer and UI/UX Designer from Salem, Tamil Nadu, India. He specializes in React, Next.js, MERN Stack, Flutter, FlutterFlow, Firebase, and TypeScript. He studied at Karpagam College of Engineering, Coimbatore.

## About

Deepakkumar V builds modern, responsive web and mobile applications. He is proficient in both frontend and backend technologies and has experience shipping production-ready products. He is open to freelance, contract, and full-time opportunities.

- Full name: Deepakkumar V
- Also known as: Deepak, Deepak Kumar
- Role: Full Stack Developer, Flutter Developer, UI/UX Designer

## Tech Stack

- Frontend: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB (MERN Stack)
- Mobile: Flutter, FlutterFlow, Dart
- Cloud & Auth: Firebase (Firestore, Auth, Hosting, Storage)
- Design: Figma, UI/UX Design principles
- Tools: Git, GitHub, VS Code, Postman
